brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:ee1e0513-1fea-463e-a.title: DFR Installation Technician
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:ee1e0513-1fea-463e-a.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. ABOUT THIS ROLE: BRINC is seeking a dynamic and proactive person to fill the role of Installer Technician. This role involves installing hardware & software for BRINC’s Drone as a First Responder (DFR) customer program. The DFR technician will travel to customer locations for installation and Seattle Headquarters as needed. The ideal candidate should have experience in computer networks, mechanical assembly, an understanding of handling/installing electronics, working understanding of low and high voltage wiring, and have a general knowledge of electronics & mechanics as it relates to hardware assembly and troubleshooting. This role requires a 75% travel commitment to engage with customers on-site, prior to, during and post implementation. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Travel to customer sites in varying weather conditions to assemble, troubleshoot, and maintain BRINC hardware and software. - Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs, provide timely service, and address any issues or concerns during implementation. - Work with internal stakeholders to troubleshoot hardware and software issues. - Work closely with internal stakeholders to advocate for customer needs and drive product enhancements based on customer feedback. - Ensure installations comply with building codes & safety standards. - Maintain strong relationships with our Law Enforcement / Public Safety customers to drive customer success and satisfaction. QUALIFICATIONS: - Ability to assemble and disassemble products, following installation guidelines & manuals when appropriate - Basic computer knowledge and networking aptitude - Basic operational knowledge of MacOS, Windows or Linux operating systems - General working experience with electronics components, low and high voltage electrical wiring, and general knowledge of mechanics as it relates to hardware assembly and troubleshooting - Experience working in a fast paced environment - Ability to work independently and in a small team, take initiative, and communicate effectively - Ability to independently book and manage all aspects of travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and itineraries. - Ability to safely climb and work from ladders at various heights, as needed for the role. - Ability to lift and carry heavy objects of varying weights, as required for the role. - Must possess a valid driver's license with a clean driving record. PREFERRED SKILLS: - Bachelor of Science Degree - 5+ years of experience in manufacturing or assembly of electronics for Aerospace, Robotics, Automotive, Consumer Electronics, or related industries - Experience manufacturing UAV/UAS systems or infrastructure for commercial, industrial, or defense applications - Exceptional Communication & Organizational Skills - Proactive and results-oriented work ethic - FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certification - Operational Experience with DFR and/or Public Safety Drone Programs - Knowledge of the Google Office Automation suite - Technical Proficiency in Drone Hardware and Software - Live within 1.5 hours of a major airport BRINC CULTURE VALUES: - Try the har

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:d26.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Culinary Lead, FT at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience by combining culinary expertise, business acumen, and teaching skills. This role supports the culinary program, drives sales, delivers a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, and helps build and manage a high-performing culinary team. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Supports the recruitment, training, and ongoing development of a high-performing team to meet the culinary business needs. · Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. · Provide in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensures an outstanding cooking class experience in every session by following provided recipes and game plans while holding employees accountable for quality and execution. · Work with store leadership to increase foot traffic and store engagement through cooking classes and private events. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist with driving sales growth by implementing strategies to enhance the culinary and retail business. · Analyze key performance metrics daily and leverage insights to optimize store performance. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets https://socket.dev/love to see for yourself!) You'll work cross-functionally in order to provide technical education, guidance, and support in a pre-sales capacity. Preferred: - CS degree or equivalent industry experience. - Hands on experience working with medium to large customers up to 1000 employees. - Relevant security domain experience and familiarity with vulnerability management SCA tools. - Experience with AI and Large Language Models (LLM) Our Interview Process 1. spmb-spmb:lever:1e87a32d-c7c4-4411-8764-.title: Associate - Denver
spmb-spmb:lever:1e87a32d-c7c4-4411-8764-.description: Company Overview: SPMB is one of the largest retained executive search firms in North America focused exclusively on technology and innovation. With a 45-year legacy rooted in Silicon Valley, the firm has built leadership teams for disruptive startups and Fortune 500 companies alike, closing more than 400 searches annually. Clients include Google, Amazon, Disney, Comcast, and Major League Baseball. For an associate joining Managing Partner Mike Doonan’s practice, SPMB offers a high-caliber yet human environment that stands apart from both the global giants and boutique firms. SPMB uniquely blends the reach and resources of a large firm with the agility of a boutique. Unlike global firms burdened by “off-limits” restrictions, SPMB can target virtually any candidate while also bringing far greater research capacity than smaller competitors. Its partners are known for rescuing searches that other firms cannot complete, thanks to deep fluency in technology and relentless urgency. Clients consistently cite SPMB’s speed, consultative approach, and ability to deliver fresh candidate slates rather than recycled lists. What sets SPMB apart is its long-term, relationship-driven ethos. The majority of searches come from repeat clients or referrals, a testament to decades of trust built “brick by brick.” The firm prioritizes cultural fit and integrity over transactions, treating candidates with respect and committing to diverse slates for every search. By investing in authentic partnerships, SPMB has created a network where today’s candidates often return as tomorrow’s clients. Even in challenging markets, SPMB has stayed true to this long-game philosophy, focusing on people, process improvements, and employee growth. Every search at SPMB is partner-led, heavily resourced, and executed with precision. The firm’s proprietary 4×4 process aims to present four qualified finalists by week four, supported by dedicated research teams. Radical transparency is delivered through Thrive TRM, a co-developed platform giving clients real-time visibility into every candidate. Today, SPMB serves venture-backed startups, PE-backed growth firms, and global enterprises alike—helping companies of all sizes build the technology leadership needed to thrive in the digital era. Position Overview: SPMB is looking for a thoughtful and professional Associate who will serve as a key member of the client delivery team by driving the candidate development process throughout each VP and C-level executive search. This role partners closely with the Partner and analyst to help deliver outstanding outcomes for our clients. Associates are responsible for working directly with our public and private clients, managing the day-to-day details of search engagements, facilitating discussions with candidates and directing the research activities of internal teams. The core function of the Associate’s role is relationship development and management, including networking and building strong relationships with senior clients and candidates. This role is an unique opportunity to interface with key senior executives as well as investors from the venture capital, private equity and public company community.
responsibilities: Gather key information from the client to gain a thorough understanding of the company, culture and position requirements.
Collaborates with the Partner and analyst to develop and execute the search strategy.
Develops key search documentation including position descriptions, candidate assessments, status updates and reference reference reports.
Helps drive research efforts and strategy to ensure the identification of high quality candidates while serving as a mentor and coach to the analyst.
Leverage large language models (LLMs) to analyze new industries, market segments and competitive landscapes to better understand our clients.
Designs AI prompts to extract strategic insights on industries, companies and executives.
Contacts potential candidates to elicit interest and to assess the candidate’s fit to the position description.
Teams with the Partner to provide our clients with an informed perspective on candidates and provide updates on the overall progress of the search assignment.
Ensures data capture of candidates, clients and search records within SPMB's databases. Add to the firm’s candidate pool expertise by identifying new talent.
